updates.list.statement: SELECT u.id, u.title, u.body, u.source, u.published_at, p.display_name AS author FROM updates u LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.user_id = u.author_id WHERE (?1 IS NULL OR u.id < ?1) AND (?2 IS NULL OR u.title LIKE '%' || ?2 || '%' OR u.body LIKE '%' || ?2 || '%') ORDER BY u.id DESC LIMIT 10

status.list.statement: SELECT component, state, detail, updated_at FROM status ORDER BY component LIMIT 20

downloads.list.statement: SELECT a.id, a.file_id, a.name, a.size, a.created_at, p.display_name AS owner_name FROM attachments a LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.user_id = a.user_id WHERE a.public = 1 ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 50

updates.post.statement: INSERT INTO updates (title, body, source, author_id, published_at) VALUES (?1, COALESCE(?2, ''), 'program', ?3, ?4)

status.report.statement: INSERT INTO status (component, state, detail, updated_at) VALUES (?1, ?2, COALESCE(?3, ''), ?4) ON CONFLICT (component) DO UPDATE SET state = excluded.state, detail = excluded.detail, updated_at = excluded.updated_at WHERE status.state IS NOT excluded.state OR status.detail IS NOT excluded.detail

status.escalated.statement: INSERT INTO escalations (component, changed_at, status, filed, error, answered_at) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, COALESCE(?5, ?6), ?7)

status.escalations.statement: SELECT component, changed_at, status, filed, error, answered_at FROM escalations ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20

me.join.statement: INSERT INTO profiles (user_id, display_name, role, joined_at) VALUES (?1, ?2, 'member', ?3) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING

me.get.statement: SELECT user_id, display_name, role, avatar_file_id, joined_at FROM profiles WHERE user_id = ?1 LIMIT 1

me.rename.guard: Another member already uses that display name, or it is yours already.
me.rename.statement: UPDATE profiles SET display_name = ?2 WHERE user_id = ?1 AND display_name IS NOT ?2 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles other WHERE lower(other.display_name) = lower(?2) AND other.user_id <> ?1)

me.avatar.statement: UPDATE profiles SET avatar_file_id = ?2 WHERE user_id = ?1

notes.list.statement: SELECT id, title, body, created_at FROM notes WHERE user_id = ?1 AND (?2 IS NULL OR id < ?2) AND (?3 IS NULL OR title LIKE '%' || ?3 || '%' OR body LIKE '%' || ?3 || '%') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20

notes.add.statement: INSERT INTO notes (user_id, title, body, created_at) VALUES (?1, ?2, COALESCE(?3, ''), ?4)

notes.remove.guard: That note is not yours, or it is already gone.
notes.remove.statement: DELETE FROM notes WHERE id = ?2 AND user_id = ?1

attachments.list.statement: SELECT id, file_id, name, size, public, created_at FROM attachments WHERE user_id = ?1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50

attachments.add.statement: INSERT INTO attachments (user_id, file_id, name, size, created_at) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5)

attachments.publish.guard: Only the member who attached this file can publish it, and only once.
attachments.publish.statement: UPDATE attachments SET public = 1 WHERE id = ?2 AND user_id = ?1 AND public = 0

attachments.remove.guard: That attachment is not yours, or it is already gone.
attachments.remove.statement: DELETE FROM attachments WHERE id = ?2 AND user_id = ?1

team.roster.statement: SELECT p.user_id, p.display_name, p.role, p.avatar_file_id FROM profiles p WHERE p.role IN ('admin', 'owner') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles caller WHERE caller.user_id = ?1 AND caller.role IN ('admin', 'owner')) ORDER BY p.display_name LIMIT 50

team.posts.statement: SELECT t.id, t.body, t.created_at, p.display_name AS author FROM team_posts t LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.user_id = t.author_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles caller WHERE caller.user_id = ?1 AND caller.role IN ('admin', 'owner')) AND (?2 IS NULL OR t.id < ?2) ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 20

team.post.guard: Only team admins can post in the team area.
team.post.statement: INSERT INTO team_posts (author_id, body, created_at) SELECT ?1, ?2, ?3 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles caller WHERE caller.user_id = ?1 AND caller.role IN ('admin', 'owner'))

updates.publish.guard: Only team admins can publish an update.
updates.publish.statement: INSERT INTO updates (title, body, source, author_id, published_at) SELECT ?2, COALESCE(?3, ''), 'team', ?1, ?4 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles caller WHERE caller.user_id = ?1 AND caller.role IN ('admin', 'owner'))

members.list.statement: SELECT p.user_id, p.display_name, p.role, p.avatar_file_id, p.joined_at FROM profiles p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles o WHERE o.user_id = ?1 AND o.role = 'owner') AND (?2 IS NULL OR p.display_name LIKE '%' || ?2 || '%') ORDER BY p.display_name LIMIT 100

members.promote.guard: Only the app's owner can make a member a team admin.
members.promote.statement: UPDATE profiles SET role = 'admin' WHERE user_id = ?1 AND role = 'member' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles o WHERE o.user_id = ?2 AND o.role = 'owner')

members.demote.guard: Only the app's owner can return a team admin to member.
members.demote.statement: UPDATE profiles SET role = 'member' WHERE user_id = ?1 AND role = 'admin' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles o WHERE o.user_id = ?2 AND o.role = 'owner')

updates.remove.guard: Only the app's owner can remove an update.
updates.remove.statement: DELETE FROM updates WHERE id = ?2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles o WHERE o.user_id = ?1 AND o.role = 'owner')

admin.stats.statement: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM profiles) AS members, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM profiles WHERE role = 'admin') AS admins, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes) AS notes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attachments) AS attachments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attachments WHERE public = 1) AS published, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM updates) AS updates WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles o WHERE o.user_id = ?1 AND o.role = 'owner') LIMIT 1
